Goal ID: goal_6dd9cb4d709a

Twice-daily automated WebXR game builds using IWSDK (Meta's WebXR framework). AM cycle at 00:00 PT and PM cycle at 12:00 PT, with hourly sentinel recovery and build summaries. **Round 11 goals — Merchant Convoys, Coral Reefs & Polish:**

1. **Merchant ships** — Neutral merchant vessels that spawn between waves. Player can choose to:
   - Attack them for bonus gold (merchant fights back weakly, has HP like a brigantine but less damage)
   - Let them pass for a "reputation bonus" — 10% shop discount for one shop visit

   - Merchants flee when attacked (move away from player at moderate speed)

2. **Coral reef zones** — Visible shallow reef patches that:
   - Appear as reddish-brown geometry slightly below water surface
   - Slow all ships (player + enemies) that enter them by 40%
   - Deal 2 HP/sec damage to any ship in the zone
   - 3-5 spawn randomly at game start, persist through all waves
   - Enemies try to path around them (add avoidance to AI)

3. **Volcanic island event** — Rare environmental event (10% chance per wave after wave 5):
   - One background island starts "erupting" — orange glow, spawns 3-5 lava rocks that arc across the play area
   - Lava rocks damage both player and enemies on impact (15 damage)
   - Lasts 8 seconds, then calms down
   - Add volcano SFX (rumble + whoosh)

4. **Quality of life polish:**
   - Show ability cooldown remaining on HUD panel
   - Show active power-up icons/timers on HUD
   - Add total merchant interactions to stats panel

- Use IWSDK 0.5.1. All imports from `@iwsdk/core`, never `three`.
- All UI via UIKitMLAsset with .uikitml files in public/ui/
- Per-frame logic in the GameSystem ECS system
- Procedural geometry for all new visuals (merchant ship, coral reefs, lava rocks)
- Procedural audio for new SFX
- Do NOT add achievements

- After implementing, run `npx tsc --noEmit` to verify clean typecheck
- Build with `npm run build` and deploy to gh-pages

```
cd ~/workspace/neon-pirate

npm run build
cd dist && rm -rf .git && git init && git checkout -b gh-pages && git add -A && git commit -m "Deploy round 11"
git remote add origin https://github.com/ellyz2426/neon-pirate.git
git push -f origin gh-pages
cd .. && rm -rf dist/.git
```

item.text:
Round 11 complete. Here's the summary:

**Neon Pirate VR — Round 11 complete and deployed.**

**What was added (865 new lines, 6,552 total LOC):**

1. **Merchant Ship Convoys** — Neutral merchant vessels spawn between waves (wave 2+). Player choice: attack for bonus gold (80+wave×10g, 3 treasure drops) or let them pass for a 10% shop discount via reputation system. Merchants have wider hull geometry with white sails and cargo crates on deck. When attacked, they flee (move away from player) and fire weak return shots. Merchant interaction stats shown on results screen.

2. **Coral Reef Zones** — 3-5 reddish-brown reef patches spawn at game start and persist all waves. Ships inside reefs are slowed 40% and take 2 HP/sec damage. Affects player, enemies, and merchants equally. Enemies have avoidance AI that steers around reef zones. Reefs have procedural geometry with coral branches, fan corals, and irregular bases.

3. **Volcanic Island Eruptions** — 10% chance per wave after wave 5. A random background island erupts with pulsing orange glow for 8 seconds, spawning 3-5 arcing lava rocks that arc across the play area. Lava rocks deal 15 damage to both player and enemies on impact, with explosions and water splashes.

4. **QoL Polish** — All 3 captain ability cooldowns now shown simultaneously on HUD (with ► marker on selected). Active power-ups display emoji icons (🚀💥🛡❤🔫) with countdown timers. Merchant interaction stats (raided/spared) on results screen. Shop shows discount indicator when reputation bonus active.

5. **3 New Procedural SFX** — Volcano rumble (deep sub-bass with crackling), lava whoosh (bandpass noise sweep), merchant horn (foghorn triangle wave).

**Status:** `waiting_continuation`, 84 total build minutes, deployed to https://ellyz2426.github.io/neon-pirate/
